item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00474","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C03","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 is a highly specific and near-contemporaneous drafting template: both orders transfer specifically described Bankhead-Jones Title III lands from agricultural administration to the Department of the Army for a named dam-and-reservoir project. They share the same operative progression—valid-rights qualification, statutory provenance, transfer language, receiving department and project purpose, detailed legal descriptions, and aggregate acreage—while adapting the state, project, and parcels. C03 and C14 share substantial Bankhead-Jones land-transfer language and machinery, but their transfers to Interior under the Taylor Grazing Act are less closely matched to the child's Army reservoir transfer.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Subject to valid existing rights, the following-described lands, acquired and administered under Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act, are hereby transferred, together with any improvements thereon, to the Department of the Army","parent_excerpt":"Subject to valid existing rights, jurisdiction over the following-described lands acquired under Title III of the said Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act ... together with waters or water rights, improvements, and structures ... is hereby transferred to the Department of the Army","explanation":"Distinctive shared operative language transfers enumerated Bankhead-Jones lands and associated improvements to the same receiving department."},{"child_excerpt":"for use, administration, and disposition in connection with the Grenada Dam and Reservoir Project, Mississippi","parent_excerpt":"for use in connection with the construction, operation, and maintenance of the Garrison Dam and Reservoir Project, North Dakota","explanation":"The same transfer machinery is adapted from one specifically named Army dam-and-reservoir project to another."},{"child_excerpt":"The above-described lands aggregate approximately 118.44 acres.","parent_excerpt":"The above-described lands administered under Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act aggregate approximately 2,863.82 acres.","explanation":"Both conclude the detailed parcel descriptions with an aggregate-acreage statement, reinforcing the parallel drafting structure."}]}
